title.why: The issuers' English cover reads 'AI Safety Governance Framework 2.0' (stored PDF, page 1); the English text runs on to page 92 under the same title.

original_title.why: The 2026 CAC notice writes 《人工智能安全治理框架2.0》 with ordinary characters, matching the record. The PDF cover quote uses Kangxi-radical code points (⼈⼯) from the PDF font; NFKC-normalised it is the same string. The old value with full-width parentheses (2.0版) was not the title on the cover.

issuing_body.why: The record keeps the old value 'TC260; drafting led by CNCERT under CAC guidance'. The cover names two bodies, TC260 and CNCERT, and the Chinese preface (page 9) says TC260 organised CNCERT and other bodies to draft. The record's wording is supported; the blind extraction's fuller wording ('TC260 and CNCERT/CC, under the guidance of CAC') matches the cover better, and the extraction itself did not change this field. Either is defensible; no fix required.

language.why: The PDF holds the Chinese text then the issuers' English text (92 pages; English 'Ensure trustworthy application and prevent loss of control' appears in the stored text).

english_version.why: kind 'authentic': the English text is in the issuers' own PDF, which carries TC260 and CNCERT on the cover. The url is the stored source archive/_runs/2026-10-14-refresh-translation-fixes/CN-13/extra-bb65e48a02/2026-10-14/official.pdf (sources.json url matches exactly).

date_published.why: CAC notice, dateline 2025年09月15日 and '9月15日，在2025年国家网络安全宣传周主论坛上...正式发布'. The cover gives only 2025-09; the notice gives the day.

status.why: Superseded. The 14 Sept 2026 CAC notice says TC260 issued 《人工智能安全治理框架3.0》 after 1.0 (2024) and 2.0 (2025). The notice does not say 2.0 is withdrawn, so 'Superseded' rests on a newer version of the same framework; the record's notes say 'Replaced by version 3.0', which is reasonable.

legal_force.why: '作为全国网安标委技术文件' (as a TC260 technical document); Non-binding is consistent.

summary.why: Claims checked against the Chinese text, see summary_claims.

safety_topics.why: The record has human oversight and international cooperation in place of the blind extraction's transparency & labelling and critical infrastructure. All four are supported by the text (human oversight: 1.5 and annex 2 '人类最终控制'; international cooperation: 5.14; labelling: 5.6; critical infrastructure: 5.5 registration of AI systems in critical information infrastructure). The first extraction's set is defensible; the blind set adds traceability of generated content, a distinctive measure, but both fit within 2 to 6 values.

notes.why: Registration of AI systems in critical information infrastructure (5.5), national standards for classification and grading (page 33, 推动人工智能应用安全分类分级国家标准制定工作), safety evaluation system (5.8) and regular developer testing for loss-of-control risk (5.11) are all in the text.

summary_claims.claim: Risk grading into five levels by application scenario, level of intelligence and scale, the top level having catastrophic and systemic features
summary_claims.locator: page 22 (5.5: 从应用场景、智能化水平、应用规模等维度入手) and annex 1, page 33: '5.特别重大安全风险 具有灾难性和系统性威胁特征'. My translation: 'Extremely serious security risk: has catastrophic and systemic threat characteristics, causing subversive or irreversible, especially severe effects on national security, social order and citizens' rights'.

summary_claims.claim: Principle of preventing loss of control and keeping AI under human control
summary_claims.locator: page 11, 1.5: '严防威胁人类生存发展的失控风险，确保人工智能始终处于人类控制之下' = 'strictly guard against loss-of-control risks that threaten human survival and development, and ensure AI is always under human control'. English text: 'Ensure trustworthy application and prevent loss of control'.

summary_claims.claim: Inherent technical, application and derivative risks
summary_claims.locator: contents: 3.1 人工智能技术内生安全风险, 3.2 技术应用安全风险, 3.3 应用衍生安全风险; catastrophic risk on page 12 ('甚至是灾难性风险').

summary_claims.claim: Ultimate human control as a basic principle of trustworthy AI (annex)
summary_claims.locator: page 35, annex 2: '1.人类最终控制 ... 使最终裁决权归属人类' = 'ultimate human control ... so that the final power of decision rests with humans'.

newer_versions: Version 3.0 issued 14 Sept 2026 (already recorded as CN-17).

scope.note: National AI safety and risk-governance framework; clearly in scope.

note: All fields supported by the stored CAC notices and the 92-page bilingual PDF; the evidence script found no errors. original_title and english_version are right: the English text is the issuers' own, in the same stored PDF. The two blind-sample differences are judgment calls. Issuing body: the record keeps the old wording, which the preface supports; the blind wording follows the cover more closely. Topics: both sets are supported by the text. A web search for a newer version was not needed beyond CN-17, which is already recorded.
